card.name: Partway through long uncommon words
card.fires_on: Mid-word pieces in the middle of rare or long words, such as interleuk|in, Amin|os|yn, anec|dot|ally and EMBRY|O. The word is not yet finished and a hyphen, letters or a name follows.

modes.label: Interleukin names
modes.description: The final piece "in" of interleukin, just before a hyphen and a number.

modes.label: Brand and technical word middles
modes.description: Middle pieces of a drug brand name or a technical term, such as Aminosyn or EMBRYO-FETAL.

modes.label: Rare ordinary words and names
modes.description: Middle pieces of rare words or proper names, such as anecdotally or Nevers.
modes.example: our scholarship might be anec<<dot>>ally correct but comprehensively wrong?

card.plain: It fires inside long or unusual words before they are finished, like interleukin or Aminosyn.
